column2: M120 site declaration — every data-raw harness that RESUMES from a checkpoint.
A site here reads a cache back and may therefore serve rows the current design
never computed; harnesses that only WRITE a checkpoint are deliberately absent
(they cannot serve a stale row). This file is the declared enumeration AC4
quantifies over — it is not, and never claims to be, a discovery procedure over
all harnesses. That job belongs to the run-time trace in checkpoint-guard.R,
which observes deserializations rather than spellings.
script       path relative to the repo root
params       the design parameters compared on resume, in the declared order;
the mismatch message names the EARLIEST differing one in this order
block        functions whose deparsed bodies form the generating-block hash —
a change to any of them invalidates the cache; a comment or
formatting change elsewhere in the script does not
unit         what one checkpoint entry covers
